sources.title: Aurora: A Foundation Model for the Earth System - GitHub
sources.snippet: Aurora is a machine learning model that can predict atmospheric variables, such as temperature. It is a foundation model, which means that it was first generally trained on a lot of data, and then can be adapted to specialised atmospheric forecasting tasks with relatively little data.
